text:
Eli: Quick thought  anyone want to do a tiny holiday puzzle swap? Leave a small 500-1000pc puzzle in the break room box, take one youd like to do over the break. :puzzle_piece:
Fern: Ooh yes. I have a half-finished snowy village I can donate. Also throwing in a packet of tea as puzzle fuel. :tea:
Carlos: Count me in. Bringing a brain-teaser puzzle (sneaky tiny pieces) and a ridiculous playlist called "Instrumental Carols for Focus". :notes:
Bea: Love it. Also mini-kudos: shoutout to ops for getting the heaters fixed this week  saved my frozen toes. :thumbsup:
Eli: Huge thanks to ops indeed. joy-bot can you add a little reminder for Fri 4pm "Puzzle swap & holiday shoutouts"? :robot_face:
joy-bot: Reminder set for Fri 16:00 in #random  "Puzzle swap & holiday shoutouts" :white_check_mark:
Fern: I taped a note on the puzzle box: "Take one, leave one, and leave a tiny holiday note if you want!"
Carlos: I left a goofy sticker with my puzzle: "If you finish before Jan, brag here." :trophy:
Bea: Will bring extra glue for rogue corners and sticky notes for the micro-kudos. See you Friday for tiny chaos and warm tea. :sparkles:
